title.zh: 卷375 列傳一百六十二 白镕 孙桓 史致俨 那清安 升寅 李宗昉 姚元之 何汝霖 季芝昌 列傳
title.en: Volume 375 Biographies 162: Bai Rong, Sun Huan, Shi Zhiyan, Na Qingan, Sheng Yin, Li Zongfang, Yao Yuanzhi, He Rulin, Ji Zhichang, Lie Chuan
title.raw: 卷375 列傳一百六十二 白镕 孙桓 史致俨 那清安 升寅 李宗昉 姚元之 何汝霖 季芝昌 列傳

sentences.zh: 白鎔，字小山，順天通州人。

translations.literal: Bai Rong, style name Xiaoshan, was a native of Tongzhou in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Rong, whose courtesy name was Xiaoshan, came from Tongzhou in Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，典福建鄉試。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he became a jinshi, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and presided over the Fujian provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Jiaqing 4, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed a compiler, and served as chief examiner for the Fujian provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 十八年，大考二等，擢贊善。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, in the grand evaluation he was ranked second class and was promoted to tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he placed in the second class in the palace examination and was promoted to tutor in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 督安徽學政，詔密詢地方利弊，疏言：「安徽錢糧，惟鳳陽、泗州遭湖、河之害，積逋較巨。

translations.literal: As educational commissioner of Anhui, he was secretly ordered to inquire into local advantages and disadvantages, and memorialized: "Of Anhui's land-tax revenues, only Fengyang and Sizhou have suffered harm from lakes and rivers, and their accumulated arrears are comparatively large.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as Anhui educational commissioner, he received a secret order to report on local conditions; he memorialized: "Among Anhui's grain and land taxes, only Fengyang and Sizhou, having suffered from lakes and rivers, carry comparatively large accumulated arrears.

sentences.zh: 遇豐稔之年，循例帶徵舊額。

translations.literal: In years of abundant harvest, by precedent they carry forward collection of the old quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In years of good harvest, by established practice they also collect the old quotas in the same levy.

sentences.zh: 在小民以一年而輸數年之賦，雖樂歲不免拮据；

translations.literal: For the common people this means paying several years' levies in a single year; even in a good year they cannot avoid strain;
translations.idiomatic: Common people must pay several years' taxes in one year, and even in a prosperous year they still feel the pinch;

sentences.zh: 而官吏懼譴，規避多方，積重難返。

translations.literal: while officials, fearing punishment, use many means of evasion, and the burden grows heavier and harder to reverse.
translations.idiomatic: while officials, fearing reprimand, resort to every evasion, so the burden piles up and becomes hard to undo.

sentences.zh: 與其存徵之名，緻小民日受追呼，國計依然無補，何如核徵之實，使官吏從容措理，舊額尚可漸清。

translations.literal: Rather than retaining the name of full collection and causing the people daily to suffer pursuing and summoning, while state revenue still gains nothing, how much better to verify what is actually collected, let officials handle matters at ease, and gradually clear the old quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Rather than keep up the pretense of full collection while the people face daily dunning with no gain to the treasury, it would be better to collect only what can truly be paid, let officials work at a manageable pace, and gradually clear the old quotas.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後二屬錢糧，每年祗帶徵一年，儻遇歉收，再行遞緩，民力漸紓，催科者自顧考成，行之必有效。

translations.literal: He requested that hereafter for the two prefectures' land taxes, each year only one year's arrears be carried forward; if harvest fails, further deferral could be applied; popular strength would gradually ease, and tax collectors, mindful of their performance reviews, would certainly implement it effectively.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that thereafter for these two jurisdictions only one year's arrears be added to each annual levy; if harvest failed, further deferral could follow. Popular strength would ease, collectors would mind their performance reviews, and the policy would surely work.

sentences.zh: 」詔允行。

translations.literal: " The edict approved implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved and ordered it carried out.

sentences.zh: 青陽有孝子曰徐守仁，幼孤，事母孝。

translations.literal: In Qingyang there was a filial son named Xu Shouren, who lost his father young and served his mother with devotion.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingyang there lived a filial son named Xu Shouren, who was orphaned young and served his mother with exemplary devotion.

sentences.zh: 母沒，廬墓三年，鎔造廬贈賻，題請旌表。

translations.literal: After his mother's death he lived by her tomb for three years; Rong built a mourning hut and provided funeral gifts, and memorialized for an official commendation.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he dwelt by her grave for three years; Rong built a mourning hut for him, gave funeral gifts, and memorialized for an official commendation.

sentences.zh: 訪求明臣左光斗遺裔，取列縣庠。

translations.literal: He sought out descendants of the Ming minister Zuo Guangdou and enrolled them in the county school.
translations.idiomatic: He searched out descendants of the Ming minister Zuo Guangdou and enrolled them in the county school.

sentences.zh: 按試所至，集士人講學，以正人心厚風俗為本。

translations.literal: Wherever he conducted examinations he gathered scholars to lecture on learning, taking rectification of hearts and thickening of customs as the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he held examinations he gathered scholars to lecture, making the rectification of hearts and the strengthening of custom his foundation.

sentences.zh: 累遷少詹事。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to junior tutor of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to junior tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，督廣東學政。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he served as educational commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 he was appointed educational commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 歷詹事、內閣學士。

translations.literal: He served successively as Grand Tutor and Academician of the Inner Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as grand tutor and as an academician of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢工部侍郎，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted Vice Minister of Works and transferred to the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was promoted vice minister of works and transferred to the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 九年，偕尚書松筠赴直隸按外委白勤被誣冤斃獄，護理總督屠之申以下降黜有差。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, together with Minister Songyun he went to Zhili to investigate the case of subordinate Bai Qin, who was falsely accused and died wrongfully in prison; Acting Governor-General Tu Zhisen and others were demoted to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he went with Minister Songyun to Zhili to investigate subordinate Bai Qin, who had been falsely accused and died unjustly in prison; Acting Governor-General Tu Zhisen and others were demoted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 督江蘇學政。

translations.literal: He served as educational commissioner of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Jiangsu educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 尋偕侍郎寶興勘視南河垛料，舉實以聞。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, together with Vice Minister Bao Xing he inspected the stockpiled materials on the southern Yellow River and reported the facts.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he joined Vice Minister Bao Xing in inspecting stockpiled materials on the southern Yellow River and reported what he found.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢左都御史，召還京，未至，命查勘江南災賑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was promoted Left Censor-in-Chief and recalled to the capital; before he arrived he was ordered to investigate disaster relief in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted left censor-in-chief and recalled to the capital; before he arrived he was ordered to inspect disaster relief in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 時尚書穆彰阿、硃士彥亦奉命勘湖、河汎溢狀，穆彰阿先回京，鎔遂偕士彥履勘沿河閘壩工程，與總督陶澍定議以工代賑。

translations.literal: At the time Ministers Mujangga and Zhu Shiyan had also been ordered to inspect flooding on lakes and rivers; Mujangga returned to the capital first, and Rong then together with Shiyan personally inspected engineering on sluices and dams along the river, and with Governor-General Tao Zhu decided on work-for-relief.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers Mujangga and Zhu Shiyan had also been ordered to survey lake and river flooding; Mujangga returned first, and Rong then with Shiyan inspected sluices and dams along the river and, with Governor-General Tao Zhu, adopted work-for-relief.

sentences.zh: 赴安徽，週曆太平、寧國、池州、安慶、廬州各郡，先後疏劾飾災侵賑諸弊。

translations.literal: He went to Anhui and toured Taiping, Ningguo, Chizhou, Anqing, Luzhou and other prefectures, successively memorializing and impeaching the abuses of exaggerating disasters and embezzling relief.
translations.idiomatic: He went to Anhui and toured Taiping, Ningguo, Chizhou, Anqing, Luzhou, and other prefectures, memorializing in turn to impeach the abuses of falsifying disasters and embezzling relief funds.

sentences.zh: 次年，回京，署翰林院掌院學士，典順天鄉試。

translations.literal: The following year he returned to the capital, served as acting chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he returned to the capital, served as acting chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢工部尚書，典武會試。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted Minister of Works and presided over the military metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was promoted minister of works and presided over the military metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 故事，武闈雙好不足額，始取單好。

translations.literal: By precedent, when double-excellence candidates were insufficient to fill the quota, single-excellence candidates were then taken.
translations.idiomatic: By established practice, when candidates with double excellence did not fill the quota, those with single excellence were admitted.

sentences.zh: 是科雙好不盡取中，坐降大理寺卿。

translations.literal: In this session not all double-excellence candidates were admitted; he was demoted to Vice President of the Court of Appeals on that account.
translations.idiomatic: In that session not all double-excellence candidates were admitted, and he was demoted to vice president of the Court of Appeals on that account.

sentences.zh: 十九年，乞病歸，卒於家，年七十四。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he requested leave on grounds of illness and returned home; he died at home aged seventy-four.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he asked leave on grounds of illness and went home; he died there at seventy-four.

sentences.zh: 鎔事母孝，教子弟嚴。

translations.literal: Rong served his mother with filial devotion and was strict in instructing his sons and nephews.
translations.idiomatic: Rong was filial toward his mother and strict in teaching his sons and nephews.

sentences.zh: 宣宗嘗嘉其家法之善，以勉朝臣雲。

translations.literal: The Daoguang Emperor once praised the excellence of his household rules, using them to encourage court officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoguang Emperor once praised the excellence of his household discipline and held it up to encourage the court.

sentences.zh: 孫桓，字建侯。

translations.literal: Sun Huan, style name Jianhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Huan, whose courtesy name was Jianhou.

sentences.zh: 同治二年進士，授吏部主事。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the second year of Tongzhi, appointed principal clerk in the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Tongzhi 2 and was appointed a principal clerk in the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 累遷郎中。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 掌選，清嚴慎密，吏不能欺，為時所稱。

translations.literal: In charge of appointments, he was austere, cautious, and meticulous; clerks could not deceive him, and he was praised by contemporaries.
translations.idiomatic: In charge of appointments, he was austere and meticulous; clerks could not deceive him, and his contemporaries praised him.

sentences.zh: 光緒中，洊擢兵部侍郎，綜覈一如為司官時。

translations.literal: In the Guangxu period he was gradually promoted to Vice Minister of War and oversaw affairs as rigorously as when he was a bureau officer.
translations.idiomatic: During the Guangxu reign he was promoted in turn to vice minister of war and oversaw affairs with the same rigor he had shown as a bureau officer.

sentences.zh: 十七年，因病乞休，尋卒。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he requested retirement on grounds of illness and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he asked to retire on grounds of illness and soon died.

sentences.zh: 史致儼，字容莊，江蘇江都人。

translations.literal: Shi Zhiyan, style name Rongzhuang, was a native of Jiangdu in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhiyan, whose courtesy name was Rongzhuang, came from Jiangdu in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 家酷貧。

translations.literal: His family was extremely poor.
translations.idiomatic: His family was desperately poor.

sentences.zh: 甫冠，為諸生，學政謝墉器其才，給膏火，居尊經閣讀書。

translations.literal: Just after coming of age he became a licentiate; Educational Commissioner Xie Yong admired his talent, provided lamp oil and paper money, and housed him in the Zunjing Pavilion to study.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly after coming of age he became a licentiate; Educational Commissioner Xie Yong valued his talent, supplied him with stipends, and lodged him in the Zunjing Pavilion to study.

sentences.zh: 薦預召試，未與選。

translations.literal: Recommended for the special imperial examination but was not selected.
translations.idiomatic: He was recommended for the special palace examination but was not chosen.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，成進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi, was selected as Hanlin bachelor, and appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 he passed the jinshi, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed a compiler.

sentences.zh: 督四川學政。

translations.literal: He served as educational commissioner of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Sichuan educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 累遷右庶子。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Right Vice Director of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to right vice director of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，督河南學政。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he served as educational commissioner of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was appointed Henan educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 自滑縣匪平，猶有伏莽，密詔偵察。

translations.literal: Since the bandits in Huaxian had been pacified, there were still hidden malcontents; he was secretly ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Although the bandits in Huaxian had been suppressed, hidden troublemakers remained, and he received a secret order to investigate.

sentences.zh: 疏陳彰、衛二郡民間習邪教猶眾，州縣編查保甲，有名無實，撰敦俗篇，刊布以化導之。

translations.literal: He memorialized that in Zhang and Wei prefectures popular practice of heterodox sects was still widespread, that prefectures and counties compiled household registers under the baojia system in name only without reality, and composed an "Exhortation on Customs" to publish for moral guidance.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that in Zhang and Wei prefectures heterodox sects were still widely practiced, that prefectures and counties kept baojia registers in name only, and he wrote an "Exhortation on Customs" and published it for moral guidance.

sentences.zh: 商丘廩生陳忠錦以不濫保被毆，知府、經歷受賕，反加斥責，忿而自經。

translations.literal: Licentiate Chen Zhongjin of Shangqiu hanged himself in indignation after being beaten for refusing to sign false guarantees; the prefect and grain intendant had taken bribes and instead added reproaches.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhongjin, a licentiate of Shangqiu, was beaten for refusing to sign false guarantees; the prefect and grain intendant had taken bribes and rebuked him instead, and he hanged himself in anger.

sentences.zh: 疏劾，譴罪有差。

translations.literal: He memorialized impeachment; punishments were meted out to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to impeach them, and punishments were assigned in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，典湖北鄉試。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he presided over the Hubei provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 he presided over the Hubei provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Academician of the Inner Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to academician of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三年，擢刑部侍郎，調禮部。

translations.literal: In the third year he was promoted Vice Minister of Punishments and transferred to the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was promoted vice minister of punishments and transferred to the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 五年，督福建學政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he served as educational commissioner of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed Fujian educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 奏分台灣舉人中額，增所屬四縣學額。

translations.literal: He memorialized to divide quota for Taiwan examinees and increase school quotas for its four subordinate counties.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to set aside a separate juren quota for Taiwan and to increase school quotas for its four subordinate counties.

sentences.zh: 漳、泉諸郡習械鬥，諸生與者，屏不與試，悍風稍息。

translations.literal: Zhangzhou and Quanzhou and other prefectures practiced armed brawling; students who took part were barred from examinations, and the violent custom gradually subsided.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangzhou, Quanzhou, and other prefectures were given to armed brawling; students who took part were barred from examinations, and the violent custom gradually subsided.

sentences.zh: 九年，偕侍郎鍾昌赴山西鞫獄，平定知州故出人罪，鞫實，論兇犯如律，褫知州恆傑職。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, together with Vice Minister Zhong Chang he went to Shanxi to try cases; the magistrate of Pingding had improperly released persons guilty of homicide; the facts were established, the principal offenders were sentenced according to law, and Magistrate Heng Jie was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he went with Vice Minister Zhong Chang to Shanxi to try cases; the magistrate of Pingding had improperly released persons guilty of homicide; the facts were established, the principal offenders were sentenced according to law, and Magistrate Heng Jie was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 調刑部，歷左都御史，遷禮部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Board of Punishments, served as Left Censor-in-Chief, and was promoted Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Board of Punishments, served as left censor-in-chief, and was promoted minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 兩典順天鄉試。

translations.literal: He twice presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He twice presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 調工部，又調刑部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Board of Works, then again to the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Board of Works and then again to the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 勤於其職，竟日坐堂上閱案牘，揅析論難，視司員如弟子。

translations.literal: Diligent in duty, he sat in court all day reviewing case documents, analyzing and debating in detail, treating bureau officers like disciples.
translations.idiomatic: Diligent in office, he sat in court all day reviewing case papers, analyzing and debating points in detail, and treating bureau officers like students.

sentences.zh: 任刑部凡四年，京察，以刑名詳慎，被議敘。

translations.literal: He served at the Board of Punishments for four years in all; in the capital evaluation he was noted for careful attention to penal matters.
translations.idiomatic: He served at the Board of Punishments for four years in all; in the capital evaluation he was commended for careful attention to penal matters.

sentences.zh: 十八年，乞解職。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he requested to resign.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he asked to leave office.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，年七十九，贈太子太保，祀鄉賢及名宦祠。

translations.literal: He soon died aged seventy-nine, posthumously granted Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, and enshrined in the local worthies and eminent officials halls.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died at seventy-nine, was posthumously granted Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, and was enshrined in the halls of local worthies and eminent officials.

sentences.zh: 那清安，字竹汀，葉赫納喇氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Na Qing'an, style name Zhuting, of the Yehe Nara clan, was a Bannerman of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Na Qing'an, whose courtesy name was Zhuting, of the Yehe Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十年進士，授戶部主事，遷翰林院侍講。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the tenth year of Jiaqing, appointed principal clerk in the Board of Revenue, promoted Reader in the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Jiaqing 10, was appointed a principal clerk in the Board of Revenue, and was promoted to Hanlin reader.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Academician of the Inner Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to academician of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，授禮部侍郎，歷刑部、工部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year appointed Vice Minister of Rites, served at Punishments and Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was appointed vice minister of rites and served in turn at the Boards of Punishments and Works.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，命赴直隸讞獄，擢左都御史，管光祿寺事，兼都統。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang ordered to Zhili to try cases, promoted Left Censor-in-Chief, supervised the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and concurrently Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 he was ordered to Zhili to try cases, was promoted left censor-in-chief, supervised the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and concurrently served as grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 尋遷兵部尚書，調刑部。

translations.literal: Shortly promoted Minister of War, transferred to Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was promoted minister of war and transferred to the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 四年，出為熱河都統，偕左都御史松筠等赴土默特讞獄，事竣，疏言：「蒙古惡習，常有移屍訛詐，為害滋甚。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he went out as Rehe Military Governor; together with Left Censor-in-Chief Songyun and others he went to Tumet to try cases; when finished he memorialized: "Among Mongol bad customs, there is frequent moving of corpses to extort and fabricate fraud, which causes ever greater harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was posted as Rehe military governor; with Left Censor-in-Chief Songyun and others he went to Tumet to try cases, and when the work was done he memorialized: "Among Mongol bad customs, moving corpses to extort and fabricate claims is common and the harm grows ever worse.

sentences.zh: 蒙古律例，凡軍流徒犯，罪止折枷，情重法輕。

translations.literal: Under Mongol statutes, for military exile, penal servitude, and exile offenders, punishment stops at commuted cangue; where circumstances are grave the law is light.
translations.idiomatic: Under Mongol law, offenders sentenced to military exile, penal servitude, or exile need only pay a commuted cangue fine; where the crime is grave the penalty is light.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後遇有假捏人命詐財者，所擬軍流徒罪即行實發，不准折枷，以懲刁惡。

translations.literal: He requested that hereafter when persons fabricate human lives to extort property, the sentences of military exile, penal servitude, and exile be actually carried out, not permitted to be commuted to cangue, to punish craftiness and wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that hereafter when anyone fabricated a death to extort money, sentences of military exile, penal servitude, or exile be carried out in full without commutation to cangue, to punish the crafty and wicked.

sentences.zh: 」下所司議行。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to the relevant office and approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was referred to the relevant office and approved for implementation.

sentences.zh: 六年，召授左都御史。

translations.literal: In the sixth year recalled and appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was recalled and appointed left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 逾年，復任熱河都統，召對，詢知其母年老，命仍還左都御史任。

translations.literal: The following year he was again appointed Rehe Military Governor; when summoned for audience the emperor inquired and learned his mother was advanced in years, and ordered him to return to his post as Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was again appointed Rehe military governor; when summoned for audience the emperor learned his mother was elderly and ordered him back to his post as left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十一年，复授兵部尚書，典順天鄉試及會試。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year again appointed Minister of War and presided over Shuntian provincial and metropolitan examinations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was again appointed minister of war and presided over the Shuntian provincial and metropolitan examinations.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以疾乞解職，允之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he requested dismissal on grounds of illness; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he asked to leave office on grounds of illness, and his request was granted.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，贈太子太保，諡恭勤。

translations.literal: He soon died, posthumously granted Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, posthumous name Gongqin (Respectful and Diligent).
translations.idiomatic: He soon died, was posthumously granted Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, and was given the posthumous name Gongqin (Respectful and Diligent).

sentences.zh: 那清安工為館體應制詩，時皆誦習。

translations.literal: Na Qing'an was skilled at composing court-style regulated verse for imperial occasions, and all recited his works.
translations.idiomatic: Na Qing'an excelled at regulated verse in the court style for imperial occasions, and everyone recited his poems.

sentences.zh: 因與穆彰阿同榜成進士，晚乃受宣宗知，迭秉文衡。

translations.literal: Because he and Mujangga passed the jinshi in the same year, only late in life did he gain the Daoguang Emperor's recognition and repeatedly held literary selection posts.
translations.idiomatic: Having passed the jinshi in the same year as Mujangga, he won the Daoguang Emperor's favor only late in life and repeatedly held literary selection posts.

sentences.zh: 既卒，會兵部以慶廉送武會試有殘疾，為監試御史所劾。

translations.literal: After his death, when the Board of War forwarded Qing Lian to the military metropolitan examination despite disability, the supervising censor impeached this.
translations.idiomatic: After his death, when the Board of War forwarded Qing Lian to the military metropolitan examination despite his disability, the supervising censor impeached the matter.

sentences.zh: 先是那清安為監射大臣，曾以慶廉殘疾扣除，上追念其持正，予其子全慶加二級。

translations.literal: Earlier when Na Qing'an was supervising archery he had disqualified Qing Lian for disability; the emperor recalled his uprightness and granted his son Quanqing an additional two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Na Qing'an supervised the archery examination, he had disqualified Qing Lian for disability; the emperor recalled his uprightness and granted his son Quanqing an additional two ranks.

sentences.zh: 全慶，光緒初官大學士，自有傳。

translations.literal: Quanqing in early Guangxu served as Grand Secretary and has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Quanqing served as grand secretary in early Guangxu and has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 昇寅，字賓旭，馬佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Sheng Yin, style name Binxu, of the Majia clan, was a Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Yin, whose courtesy name was Binxu, of the Majia clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 拔貢，考授禮部七品小京官。

translations.literal: Selected as tribute scholar, passed examination and appointed seventh-rank clerk in the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Selected as a tribute scholar, he passed the examination and was appointed a seventh-rank clerk in the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 舉嘉慶五年鄉試。

translations.literal: Passed provincial examination in fifth year of Jiaqing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination in Jiaqing 5.

sentences.zh: 累遷員外郎，改御史。

translations.literal: Repeatedly promoted to bureau director, then transferred to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to bureau director and was then transferred to the censorate.

sentences.zh: 疏言學校為人才根本，請嚴課程，務實用，戒奢靡；

translations.literal: He memorialized that schools are the root of talent and requested strict curriculum, practical utility, and restraint of luxury;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that schools are the foundation of talent and asked for strict curricula, practical training, and restraint of luxury;

sentences.zh: 又疏陳防禁考試八旗生懷挾冒替諸弊：從之。

translations.literal: He also memorialized on preventing cheating in banner student examinations including hidden slips and impersonation: approved.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized on preventing banner students from cheating in examinations by hidden slips, impersonation, and similar abuses: the court approved.

sentences.zh: 改右庶子，累遷副都御史。

translations.literal: Transferred to Right Vice Director, repeatedly promoted to Vice President of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to right vice director of the Hanlin Academy and rose through successive posts to vice president of the censorate.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，授盛京禮部侍郎，署盛京將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year appointed Vice Minister of Rites at Mukden and acting Mukden Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was appointed vice minister of rites at Mukden and acting Mukden military governor.

sentences.zh: 調刑部，召為工部侍郎，又調刑部。

translations.literal: Transferred to Punishments, recalled as Vice Minister of Works, then again Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Board of Punishments, recalled as vice minister of works, and then transferred again to the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 道光六年，出為熱河都統。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Daoguang went out as Rehe Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 6 he was posted as Rehe military governor.

sentences.zh: 以蒙古各旗招內地遊民開採煤礦，往往生事械鬥，疏請諭禁，從之。

translations.literal: Because Mongol banners recruited inland migrants to open coal mines and fighting often resulted, he memorialized requesting prohibition - approved.
translations.idiomatic: Because Mongol banners recruited inland migrants to open coal mines and brawls often followed, he memorialized asking for a prohibition, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 八年，命赴甘肅偕總督鄂山按寧夏將軍慶山、副都統噶普唐阿互劾事，罷慶山，即以昇寅代之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year ordered to Gansu with Governor-General Eshan to investigate mutual impeachment of Ningxia General Qingshan and Vice President Gaputang'a; Qingshan was dismissed and Sheng Yin replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was ordered to Gansu with Governor-General Eshan to investigate the mutual impeachment of Ningxia General Qingshan and Vice President Gaputang'a; Qingshan was dismissed and Sheng Yin replaced him.

sentences.zh: 歷成都、綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: He served successively as Military Governors of Chengdu and Suiyuancheng.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as military governor of Chengdu and of Suiyuancheng.

sentences.zh: 命鞫鄂爾多斯京控獄，奏言：「蒙古京控日繁，請自後各部落封禁地樹立界牌，以杜私墾；

translations.literal: Ordered to try cases from Ordos appealed to the capital; he memorialized: "Mongol appeals to the capital grow daily; hereafter in each tribe's sealed lands set up boundary markers to stop illicit cultivation;
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to try cases from Ordos appealed to the capital, he memorialized: "Appeals from Mongols to the capital grow daily; hereafter boundary markers should be set up on each tribe's sealed lands to stop illicit cultivation;

sentences.zh: 蒙古阿勒巴圖禁止餽贈，以息爭端；

translations.literal: prohibit Mongol subjects from accepting gifts to quell disputes;
translations.idiomatic: Mongol subjects should be forbidden to accept gifts, to quell disputes;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克王、貝勒等毋用內地書吏，以免教唆；

translations.literal: princes, beile and others should not employ inland clerks to avoid instigation;
translations.idiomatic: jasak princes, beile, and others should not employ inland clerks, to avoid instigation;

sentences.zh: 各旗協理台吉，會同盟長選舉，以昭慎重；

translations.literal: for each banner's assistant taiji, jointly elect through league chiefs to show solemnity;
translations.idiomatic: assistant taiji for each banner should be chosen jointly with league chiefs, to show due care;

sentences.zh: 盟長會盟需用烏拉，應明定限制，以免浮索：庶積弊清而獄訟息。

translations.literal: League chiefs need wula for league assemblies; limits should be clearly set to avoid excessive levies: so accumulated abuses may be cleared and lawsuits cease.
translations.idiomatic: League chiefs require wula (tribute goods) for league assemblies; clear limits should be set to prevent excessive demands, so that accumulated abuses may be cleared and litigation cease.

sentences.zh: 十一年，召授左都御史，兼都統。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, summoned and appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left, concurrently serving as colonel general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was summoned and appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left, concurrently serving as colonel general.

sentences.zh: 十二年，署工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he served as acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 京畿旱，疏請發米，設十廠煮粥以濟災民，從之。

translations.literal: The capital region suffered drought; he memorialized requesting grain distribution and ten kitchens to cook congee to relieve disaster victims; approved.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital region suffered drought, he memorialized requesting the release of grain and the establishment of ten soup kitchens to feed disaster victims; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十三年，偕侍郎鄂順安按西安將軍徐錕貪縱，得實，議褫職。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, together with Vice President E Shun'an investigated Xi'an General Xu Kun for greed and indulgence; facts were established and dismissal from office was recommended.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, together with Vice President E Shun'an, he investigated Xi'an General Xu Kun for corruption and lax discipline; the charges were substantiated and dismissal from office was recommended.

sentences.zh: 十四年，命閱兵山東、河南，就鞫桐柏知縣寧飛濱故出人罪，治如律。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, ordered to inspect troops in Shandong and Henan; on the spot tried Tongbai Magistrate Ning Feibin for the crime of deliberately releasing a prisoner; punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was ordered to inspect troops in Shandong and Henan; en route he tried Tongbai Magistrate Ning Feibin on the spot for unlawfully releasing a prisoner and punished him according to law.

sentences.zh: 命赴廣東、湖南按事，授禮部尚書，未至，卒於途。

translations.literal: Ordered to Guangdong and Hunan to investigate affairs; appointed Minister of Rites; before arriving, died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to Guangdong and Hunan to investigate affairs and was appointed Minister of Rites, but before he arrived he died on the journey.

sentences.zh: 優詔賜卹，稱其老成清介，贈太子太保，諡勤直。

translations.literal: A gracious edict granted mourning honors, praising his mature uprightness and integrity; posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; posthumous title Qinzhí.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict granted generous mourning honors, praising him as mature, upright, and incorruptible; he was posthumously granted the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Qinzhí (Diligent and Upright).

sentences.zh: 子寶琳，直隸保定知府，濬定州洿澤，有治績；

translations.literal: His son Baolin, Prefect of Baoding in Zhili, dredged the foul marshes of Dingzhou and had administrative achievements;
translations.idiomatic: His son Baolin served as prefect of Baoding in Zhili, dredged the foul marshes of Dingzhou, and won a reputation for good governance;

sentences.zh: 寶珣，同治中，官兵部侍郎、山海關副都統。

translations.literal: Baoxun, in the Tongzhi reign, served as Vice President of the Board of War and Vice President at Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: Baoxun, during the Tongzhi reign, served as Vice President of the Board of War and as Vice President at Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 孫紹祺，咸豐六年進士，由編修官至理籓院尚書；

translations.literal: His grandson Shaoqi, jinshi in the sixth year of Xianfeng, rose from compiler to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Shaoqi, a jinshi of Xianfeng 6, rose from compiler to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs;

sentences.zh: 紹諴，光緒中，山西布政使，從治鄭州河工，終駐藏大臣；

translations.literal: Shaoxuan, in the Guangxu reign, Financial Commissioner of Shanxi, assisted in managing the Zhengzhou river works, and finally served as Resident Commissioner in Tibet;
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxuan, during the Guangxu reign, served as financial commissioner of Shanxi, assisted in managing the Zhengzhou river works, and ultimately became Resident Commissioner in Tibet;

sentences.zh: 紹英，宣統初，度支部侍郎，內務府大臣。

translations.literal: Shaoying, at the beginning of the Xuantong reign, Vice President of the Board of Revenue and Minister of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoying, in the early Xuantong reign, served as Vice President of the Board of Revenue and as Minister of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 李宗昉，字芝齡，江蘇山陽人。

translations.literal: Li Zongfang, style name Zhiling, was a native of Shanyang in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zongfang, whose courtesy name was Zhiling, came from Shanyang in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶七年一甲二名進士，授編修，典陝甘鄉試。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiaqing, jinshi ranked second in the first class; appointed compiler; presided over the Shaanxi-Gansu provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 7 he placed second in the first class of jinshi, was appointed a compiler, and presided over the Shaanxi-Gansu provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 大考二等，擢贊善。

translations.literal: In the grand evaluation ranked second class; promoted to tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the palace examination he placed in the second class and was promoted to tutor in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 督貴州學政，累遷侍讀學士，督浙江學政。

translations.literal: Served as educational commissioner of Guizhou; successively promoted to Reader in the Hanlin Academy; served as educational commissioner of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He served as educational commissioner of Guizhou, was promoted to Reader in the Hanlin Academy, and then served as educational commissioner of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 歷詹事、內閣學士。

translations.literal: He served as Grand Tutor and as a Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as Grand Tutor and as a Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，授禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang, appointed Vice President of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 he was appointed Vice President of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 次年，典會試，又典江西鄉試，留學政。

translations.literal: The next year, presided over the metropolitan examination; also presided over the Jiangxi provincial examination; retained as educational commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he presided over the metropolitan examination and also over the Jiangxi provincial examination, and remained in office as educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 值大水，歲饑，與巡撫籌賑務，多所全活。

translations.literal: When great floods struck and the year brought famine, together with the governor he planned relief work and saved many lives.
translations.idiomatic: When severe floods and famine struck, he worked with the governor to organize relief and saved many lives.

sentences.zh: 調戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Transferred to Vice President of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice President of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 初，宗昉督學貴州時，巡撫議丈全省田為增賦計，民情惶駭，會檄學官徵集圖書，得御史包承祚奏疏，乾隆初，學政鄒一桂請丈田，而承祚奏駁之，極言黔中山多平地少，民每虛佔不毛之地，胥吏高下其手，以丈高下不可準之田，賦未必增，民受其害。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zongfang was educational commissioner of Guizhou, the governor proposed surveying all provincial fields to increase taxation; the people were terrified; by chance an order went to educational officials to collect books and documents, and he obtained a memorial from Censor Bao Chengzuo: in the early Qianlong reign, Educational Commissioner Zou Yigui requested land survey, but Chengzuo memorialized in rebuttal, stating emphatically that in Qian there are many mountains and little flat land, people often falsely claim barren ground, clerks manipulate the figures, and by surveying fields of uneven quality taxation may not increase while the people suffer harm.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, while Zongfang was serving as educational commissioner of Guizhou, the governor proposed surveying all fields in the province to increase tax revenue, alarming the populace. Educational officials were ordered to collect books and documents, and Zongfang found a memorial by Censor Bao Chengzuo: in the early Qianlong reign, Educational Commissioner Zou Yigui had requested a land survey, but Chengzuo had memorialized against it, arguing forcefully that Guizhou has more mountains than flat land, that people often falsely claim barren ground, that clerks manipulate the figures, and that surveying fields of uneven quality would not necessarily increase revenue but would harm the people.

sentences.zh: 部議停止，宗昉持以示巡撫曰：「此事學臣嘗奏之，被駁。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and halted it; Zongfang took it to show the governor and said: "On this matter the educational commissioner once memorialized and was rejected.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated and ordered the plan stopped. Zongfang took the document to the governor and said, "The educational commissioner once memorialized on this matter and was rejected.

sentences.zh: 今必解其所駁乃可。

translations.literal: Now one must explain the grounds of that rejection before proceeding.
translations.idiomatic: Before proceeding now, the grounds of that rejection must be addressed.

sentences.zh: 」巡撫亦悟，事得寢。

translations.literal: " The governor also understood, and the matter was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: " The governor understood as well, and the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 至是，官戶部，署巡撫麟慶因復奏上其事，部援故事詳覆之，乃定議不行。

translations.literal: By this time, holding office in the Board of Revenue, Acting Governor Lin Qing again memorialized on the matter; the ministry cited precedent in a detailed reply and finally decided not to proceed.
translations.idiomatic: By then, while serving in the Board of Revenue, Acting Governor Lin Qing again memorialized on the matter; the ministry cited precedent in a detailed reply and finally decided against it.

sentences.zh: 歷工部、吏部侍郎，兼管國子監、順天府尹事。

translations.literal: He served as Vice President of the Boards of Works and Personnel, concurrently managing affairs of the Imperial Academy and the Governor of Shuntian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Vice President of the Boards of Works and Personnel, concurrently overseeing the Imperial Academy and the governorship of Shuntian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 自七年至十年，典順天鄉試二，會試一，浙江鄉試一，得士稱盛。

translations.literal: From the seventh to the tenth year, presided twice over the Shuntian provincial examination, once over the metropolitan examination, and once over the Zhejiang provincial examination; the scholars selected were highly praised.
translations.idiomatic: From the seventh to the tenth year he presided twice over the Shuntian provincial examination, once over the metropolitan examination, and once over the Zhejiang provincial examination, and the scholars he selected were widely acclaimed.

sentences.zh: 擢左都御史、禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Promoted to Censor-in-Chief of the Left and Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Censor-in-Chief of the Left and Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，以疾乞休。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, on grounds of illness requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he requested retirement on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，卒，依例賜卹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, died; mourning honors granted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-sixth year and was granted mourning honors according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 姚元之，字伯昂，安徽桐城人。

translations.literal: Yao Yuanzhi, style name Bo'ang, was a native of Tongcheng in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanzhi, whose courtesy name was Bo'ang, came from Tongcheng in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，典陝甘鄉試。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the tenth year of Jiaqing; selected as Hanlin bachelor; appointed compiler; presided over the Shaanxi-Gansu provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Jiaqing 10, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed a compiler, and presided over the Shaanxi-Gansu provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 入直南書房。

translations.literal: Entered service in the Southern Library.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service in the Southern Library.

sentences.zh: 給事中花傑劾戴衢亨、英和援引，詔元之文字本佳，斥傑詆訐，尋亦罷元之入直。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Hua Jie impeached Dai Quheng and Ying He for favoritism in appointments; an edict said Yuanzhi's writing was originally excellent and rebuked Jie for slander; soon Yuanzhi's service in the Southern Library was also ended.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Hua Jie impeached Dai Quheng and Ying He for favoritism in appointments; an edict declared that Yuanzhi's writing was originally excellent and rebuked Jie for slander, but soon Yuanzhi was also removed from service in the Southern Library.

sentences.zh: 十七年，大考一等，擢侍講。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, grand evaluation first class; promoted to Reader.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he placed in the first class in the palace examination and was promoted to Reader.

sentences.zh: 復以武英殿刊刻聖訓有誤，仍降編修。

translations.literal: Again, because the Hall of Military Glory printing of the Sacred Instructions contained errors, he was demoted back to compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Again, because errors were found in the Hall of Military Glory edition of the Sacred Instructions, he was demoted back to compiler.

sentences.zh: 十九年，督河南學政，疏禁坊刻類典等書以杜剿襲；

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, educational commissioner of Henan; memorialized banning commercially printed imitation-classics and similar books to stop plagiarism;
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, as educational commissioner of Henan, he memorialized banning commercially printed imitation-classics and similar books to stop plagiarism;

sentences.zh: 又密陳河南與安徽、湖北交界地多捻匪，陳州、汝寧鹽運迥殊，土匪把持：並嘉納之。

translations.literal: also secretly reported that borderlands between Henan and Anhui and Hubei had many Nian bandits, that salt transport in Chenzhou and Runing differed greatly, and that local bandits controlled the trade: all were commended and adopted.
translations.idiomatic: he also secretly reported that the borderlands between Henan and Anhui and Hubei harbored many Nian bandits, that salt transport in Chenzhou and Runing differed greatly, and that local bandits controlled the trade; all these proposals were commended and adopted.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: Successively promoted to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 道光十三年，授工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Daoguang, appointed Vice President of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 13 he was appointed Vice President of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 疏陳台灣營務積弊，窩娼聚賭，械鬥殺人，操演僱人替代，詔下閩督嚴察整頓。

translations.literal: Memorialized on accumulated abuses in Taiwan garrison affairs: harboring prostitutes and gambling gatherings, armed fights and killings, hiring substitutes for drill; an edict ordered the Fujian governor-general to investigate strictly and rectify.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized on accumulated abuses in Taiwan garrison affairs—harboring prostitutes and gambling dens, armed fights and killings, and hiring substitutes for drill—and an edict ordered the Fujian governor-general to investigate strictly and rectify the situation.

sentences.zh: 調戶部，又調刑部。

translations.literal: Transferred to the Board of Revenue, then to the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Board of Revenue and then to the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 迭典順天、江西鄉試。

translations.literal: In succession presided over the Shuntian and Jiangxi provincial examinations.
translations.idiomatic: He presided in turn over the Shuntian and Jiangxi provincial examinations.

sentences.zh: 督浙江學政，未滿，十八年，擢左都御史，召回京。

translations.literal: Educational commissioner of Zhejiang; before his term was complete, in the eighteenth year promoted to Censor-in-Chief of the Left and recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as educational commissioner of Zhejiang, before his term was complete, in the eighteenth year he was promoted to Censor-in-Chief of the Left and recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 尋以南昌知府張寅為江西巡撫裕泰劾罷，元之為寅疏辯，臚陳政績，請查辦，詔斥冒昧，降二級調用。

translations.literal: Soon after, Nanchang Prefect Zhang Yin was impeached and dismissed by Jiangxi Governor Yutai; Yuanzhi memorialized in Zhang's defense, setting forth his achievements in detail and requesting investigation; an edict rebuked his presumption and demoted him two ranks with reassignment.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, when Nanchang Prefect Zhang Yin was impeached and dismissed by Jiangxi Governor Yutai, Yuanzhi memorialized in Zhang's defense, setting forth his achievements in detail and requesting an investigation; an edict rebuked his presumption and demoted him two ranks with reassignment.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，海防方亟，疏陳廣東形勢，豫籌戰守，下靖逆將軍奕山等採行。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, coastal defense was urgently needed; he memorialized on Guangdong's strategic situation and planned in advance for offense and defense; the memorial was sent down to General for Pacifying Rebellion Yishan and others to adopt.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, when coastal defense was urgently needed, he memorialized on Guangdong's strategic situation and proposed plans for offense and defense; the memorial was sent down to General for Pacifying Rebellion Yishan and others for implementation.

sentences.zh: 授內閣學士。

translations.literal: Appointed Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，京察，以年衰休致。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, capital personnel evaluation; on grounds of advanced age retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, in the capital personnel evaluation, he retired on grounds of advanced age.

sentences.zh: 元之學於族祖鼐，文章爾雅，書畫並工。

translations.literal: Yuanzhi studied under his clan ancestor Nai; his prose was refined and elegant, and he was skilled in both calligraphy and painting.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanzhi studied under his clan elder Nai; his prose was refined and elegant, and he was accomplished in both calligraphy and painting.

sentences.zh: 習於掌故，館閣推為祭酒。

translations.literal: Well versed in institutional precedents, the academy offices regarded him as their dean.
translations.idiomatic: Well versed in institutional precedents, he was regarded by the Hanlin and academy offices as their leading authority.

sentences.zh: 愛士好事，穆彰阿素重之。

translations.literal: He loved scholars and delighted in good works; Muzhanga had long valued him highly.
translations.idiomatic: He loved scholars and delighted in good works, and Muzhanga had long held him in high regard.

sentences.zh: 後以論洋務不合，乃被黜。

translations.literal: Later, because his views on foreign affairs did not accord, he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because his views on foreign affairs did not accord with prevailing opinion, he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Xianfeng 2.

sentences.zh: 何汝霖，字雨人，江蘇江寧人。

translations.literal: He Rulin, style name Yuren, was a native of Jiangning in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He Rulin, whose courtesy name was Yuren, came from Jiangning in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 拔貢，考授工部七品小京官。

translations.literal: Selected tribute student; through examination appointed seventh-rank clerk in the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: As a selected tribute student, he passed the examination and was appointed a seventh-rank clerk in the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 中式道光五年舉人，充軍機章京，累遷郎中。

translations.literal: Passed the provincial examination in the fifth year of Daoguang; served as Grand Council clerk; successively promoted to department director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination in Daoguang 5, served as a Grand Council clerk, and was promoted to department director.

sentences.zh: 歷內閣侍讀學士、大理寺少卿。

translations.literal: He served as Reader in the Hanlin Academy and as Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Reader in the Hanlin Academy and as Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 偕侍郎恩桂按事浙江，查勘南河料垛。

translations.literal: Together with Vice President En Gui investigated affairs in Zhejiang and inspected stored materials of the Southern River.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Vice President En Gui, he investigated affairs in Zhejiang and inspected stored materials for the Southern River works.

sentences.zh: 命在軍機大臣上行走，歷宗人府丞、副都御史。

translations.literal: Ordered to attend upon the Grand Council ministers; served as Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court and as Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to serve on the staff of the Grand Council ministers and served in turn as Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court and as Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，授兵部侍郎，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, appointed Vice President of the Board of War; transferred to the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was appointed Vice President of the Board of War and then transferred to the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 偕大學士敬徵勘東河工程。

translations.literal: Together with Grand Secretary Jingzheng inspected Eastern River engineering works.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Grand Secretary Jingzheng, he inspected the Eastern River engineering works.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，擢兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, promoted to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was promoted to Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 值太后七旬萬壽，汝霖母丁年九十，五世同堂，賜御書扁額，尋以母憂歸。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager's seventieth birthday was celebrated, Rulin's mother, née Ding, was ninety sui and five generations lived under one roof; an imperial calligraphy plaque was bestowed; soon after he returned home for mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: On the occasion of the Empress Dowager's seventieth birthday, Rulin's mother, née Ding, was ninety sui and five generations lived under one roof; an imperial calligraphy plaque was bestowed, but soon afterward he returned home to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 江蘇大水，命在籍襄治賑務。

translations.literal: Jiangsu suffered great floods; ordered while at home to assist in managing relief work.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangsu suffered severe floods, he was ordered, while at home, to assist in managing relief work.

sentences.zh: 先是，總督陶澍於江寧立豐備倉以備荒，縣令虧挪穀價，大吏許以他款抵。

translations.literal: Earlier, Governor-General Tao Shu had established the Fengbei Granary in Jiangning against famine; the county magistrate embezzled and diverted grain funds, and senior officials allowed offset with other funds.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Governor-General Tao Shu had established the Fengbei Granary in Jiangning as a famine reserve, but the county magistrate embezzled and diverted grain funds, and senior officials allowed the shortfall to be offset with other funds.

sentences.zh: 汝霖曰：「倉穀以備兇。

translations.literal: Rulin said: "Granary grain is kept against famine.
translations.idiomatic: Rulin said, "Granary grain is kept against famine.

sentences.zh: 今荒像如此，汝霖不敢欺朝廷，當各為奏上。

translations.literal: Now famine conditions are such as this; Rulin dares not deceive the court and should each report upward separately.
translations.idiomatic: Now that famine conditions are so severe, I dare not deceive the court; each of us should report separately to the throne.

sentences.zh: 」乃以給賑用。

translations.literal: " Then the grain was used for relief.
translations.idiomatic: " The grain was then used for relief.

sentences.zh: 服闋，命以一品頂戴署禮部侍郎，尋署戶部尚書，仍直軍機處，授禮部尚書。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, ordered to serve with first-rank hat ornament as acting Vice President of the Board of Rites; soon acting Minister of the Board of Revenue; still served at the Grand Council; appointed Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning period ended, he was ordered to serve with first-rank hat ornament as acting Vice President of the Board of Rites, soon as acting Minister of the Board of Revenue, while continuing to serve at the Grand Council; he was then appointed Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 汝霖久襄樞務，資勞己深，尚書陳孚恩由章京躋大臣，駸用事，厭汝霖居其前。

translations.literal: Rulin had long assisted in core state affairs and his seniority and service were deep; Minister Chen Fu'en had risen from Grand Council clerk to grand minister and gradually came to wield power, resenting Rulin's precedence over him.
translations.idiomatic: Rulin had long assisted in core state affairs and his seniority and service were considerable; Minister Chen Fu'en, who had risen from Grand Council clerk to grand minister, gradually came to wield power and resented Rulin's precedence over him.

sentences.zh: 汝霖年逾七十，一日在直，觸火爐幾僕。

translations.literal: Rulin was over seventy; one day on duty at the council, he bumped into the brazier and nearly fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rulin was over seventy; one day while on duty at the council, he bumped into the brazier and nearly fell.

sentences.zh: 孚恩笑曰：「人當避爐，爐豈能避人？

translations.literal: Fu'en smiled and said: "A man should avoid the brazier; can a brazier avoid a man?
translations.idiomatic: Fu'en smiled and said, "A man should avoid the brazier; can a brazier avoid a man?

sentences.zh: 」汝霖知其諷己，咸豐二年，以足疾乞罷直，許之。

translations.literal: " Rulin knew he was being mocked; in the second year of Xianfeng, on grounds of foot ailment requested to leave council duty; permitted.
translations.idiomatic: " Rulin knew he was being mocked; in Xianfeng 2, on grounds of a foot ailment he requested to leave council duty, and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，諡恪慎，祀鄉賢。

translations.literal: Before long, died; posthumous title Ke Shen; enshrined among local worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died and was given the posthumous name Ke Shen (Respectful and Prudent); he was enshrined among local worthies.

sentences.zh: 子兆瀛，浙江鹽運使。

translations.literal: His son Zhaoying, Salt Transport Commissioner of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhaoying served as Salt Transport Commissioner of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 季芝昌，字仙九，江蘇江陰人。

translations.literal: Ji Zhichang, style name Xianjiu, was a native of Jiangyin in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Zhichang, whose courtesy name was Xianjiu, came from Jiangyin in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 父麟，直隸鉅鹿知縣，居官慈惠。

translations.literal: His father Lin, Magistrate of Julu in Zhili, was benevolent and gracious in office.
translations.idiomatic: His father Lin served as magistrate of Julu in Zhili and was benevolent and gracious in office.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十八年，捕邪教，焚其籍，免株連數千人。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Jiaqing, he arrested a heterodox sect, burned its registers, and spared several thousand people from guilt by association.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 18 he suppressed a heterodox sect, burned its registers, and spared several thousand people from guilt by association.

sentences.zh: 坐捕匪不力，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: Convicted of insufficient effort in suppressing bandits; banished to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Convicted of insufficient effort in suppressing bandits, he was banished to Ili.

sentences.zh: 芝昌年逾四十，成道光十二年一甲三名進士，授編修，散館第一。

translations.literal: Zhichang was over forty; became jinshi ranked third in the first class in the twelfth year of Daoguang; appointed compiler; first in the Hanlin graduation evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhichang was over forty when he placed third in the first class of jinshi in Daoguang 12, was appointed a compiler, and ranked first in the Hanlin graduation evaluation.

sentences.zh: 未幾，大考第三，擢侍讀，督山東學政。

translations.literal: Before long, grand evaluation third place; promoted to Reader; educational commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he placed third in the palace examination, was promoted to Reader, and served as educational commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十九年，大考复第三，擢少詹事，晉詹事，典江西鄉試，督浙江學政。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, grand evaluation again third place; promoted to Junior Grand Tutor, then Grand Tutor; presided over the Jiangxi provincial examination; educational commissioner of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he again placed third in the palace examination, was promoted to Junior Grand Tutor and then Grand Tutor, presided over the Jiangxi provincial examination, and served as educational commissioner of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 母憂歸，服闋，擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: Returned home for mourning for his mother; when mourning ended, promoted to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home to mourn his mother, and when the mourning period ended he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，授禮部侍郎，督安徽學政，調吏部，又調倉場。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, appointed Vice President of the Board of Rites; educational commissioner of Anhui; transferred to the Board of Personnel; then to the grain depot.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was appointed Vice President of the Board of Rites and educational commissioner of Anhui, then transferred to the Board of Personnel and afterward to the grain depot.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，命偕定郡王載銓籌辦長蘆鹽務，清查天津倉庫，疏陳：「蘆鹽積累，各商憚於承運，懸岸至四十餘處。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, ordered together with Prince of Ding Zaiquan to manage Changlu salt affairs and inspect Tianjin warehouses; memorialized: "Changlu salt has accumulated; merchants fear undertaking transport; suspended distribution points reach more than forty.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was ordered, together with Prince of Ding Zaiquan, to manage Changlu salt affairs and inspect Tianjin warehouses; he memorialized: "Changlu salt has accumulated, merchants are reluctant to undertake transport, and suspended distribution points number more than forty.

sentences.zh: 請將河南二十四州縣仿淮南例改票鹽，先課後引。

translations.literal: Request that twenty-four prefectures and counties in Henan follow the Huainan precedent and switch to ticket salt, collecting tax first and issuing certificates afterward.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that twenty-four prefectures and counties in Henan follow the Huainan precedent and switch to the ticket-salt system, collecting tax first and issuing certificates afterward.

sentences.zh: 直隸二十四州縣限半年招商招販，無商販即責成州縣領運，或由鹽政遴員官運。

translations.literal: In twenty-four prefectures and counties of Zhili, within half a year recruit merchants and dealers; if none come, hold prefectures and counties responsible to lead transport, or let the salt commissioner select officials for official transport.
translations.idiomatic: In twenty-four prefectures and counties of Zhili, merchants and dealers should be recruited within half a year; if none come forward, prefectures and counties should be held responsible to lead transport, or the salt commissioner should select officials for official transport.

sentences.zh: 支銷浮費及官役陋規，永遠裁汰。

translations.literal: Disbursements of inflated expenses and illicit customary fees of officials and clerks should be permanently abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Inflated expenses and illicit customary fees paid to officials and clerks should be permanently abolished.

sentences.zh: 每年應完帑利，灘及通綱額引，與正課一律徵收。

translations.literal: Each year the treasury profits due, beach and general quota salt certificates, should be collected uniformly with the regular tax.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the treasury profits due, along with beach and general quota salt certificates, should be collected uniformly with the regular tax.

sentences.zh: 其協濟補欠充公等項加價名目，概行革除。

translations.literal: Surcharge items such as mutual aid, arrears makeup, and confiscation should all be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Surcharge items such as mutual aid, arrears makeup, and confiscation should all be abolished.

sentences.zh: 並於各引鹽加斤免課，每斤准其減價敵私。

translations.literal: Also add weight to each salt certificate exempt from tax, allowing each catty to be sold at reduced price to compete with smuggled salt.
translations.idiomatic: Weight should also be added to each salt certificate exempt from tax, allowing each catty to be sold at a reduced price to compete with smuggled salt.

sentences.zh: 」詔依議行。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered implementation as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered implementation as proposed.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，偕大學士耆英赴浙江閱兵，並清查倉庫，籌辦鹽務。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, together with Grand Secretary Qishan went to Zhejiang to inspect troops, also inspect warehouses, and manage salt affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, together with Grand Secretary Qishan, he went to Zhejiang to inspect troops, inspect warehouses, and manage salt affairs.

sentences.zh: 途經東河、南河，查詢節浮費、裁冗員事宜，奏減東河正款二十萬兩，裁泉河通判、歸河通判，南河每年用款以三百萬兩為率，減省五六十萬兩，並揚運通判於江防廳，改為江運同知，裁丹陽縣丞、靈壁主簿、呂梁洪巡檢，從之。

translations.literal: Passing through the Eastern and Southern Rivers, inquired into reducing inflated expenses and cutting redundant posts; memorialized reducing the Eastern River regular appropriation by two hundred thousand taels, abolishing the Quanhe and Guihe assistant prefects; setting the Southern River annual expenditure at three million taels as the standard, reducing by five or six hundred thousand taels; also transferring the Yangyun assistant prefect to the River Defense Office, changing the post to River Transport Sub-Prefect; abolishing the Danyang Assistant Magistrate, Lingbi Registrar, and Lülianghong Inspector; approved.
translations.idiomatic: En route through the Eastern and Southern Rivers, he inquired into reducing inflated expenses and cutting redundant posts; he memorialized reducing the Eastern River regular appropriation by two hundred thousand taels and abolishing the Quanhe and Guihe assistant prefects; he proposed setting the Southern River annual expenditure at three million taels as the standard, with a reduction of five or six hundred thousand taels; he also proposed transferring the Yangyun assistant prefect to the River Defense Office as River Transport Sub-Prefect, and abolishing the Danyang Assistant Magistrate, Lingbi Registrar, and Lülianghong Inspector; all were approved.

sentences.zh: 耆英病留清江浦，芝昌獨赴浙江，疏陳變通鹽務章程七事：杭、嘉、紹三所引鹽，分別加斤，止令完交正課；

translations.literal: Qishan fell ill and remained at Qingjiangpu; Zhichang went alone to Zhejiang and memorialized seven revised salt regulations: for salt certificates of the Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Shaoxing offices, add weight separately and require only payment of the regular tax;
translations.idiomatic: When Qishan fell ill and remained at Qingjiangpu, Zhichang went alone to Zhejiang and memorialized seven revised salt regulations: for salt certificates of the Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Shaoxing offices, weight should be added separately and only the regular tax required;

sentences.zh: 松所引鹽，酌裁科則；

translations.literal: for salt certificates of the Songjiang office, appropriately reduce tax schedules;
translations.idiomatic: for salt certificates of the Songjiang office, tax schedules should be appropriately reduced;

sentences.zh: 虛懸口岸，選商接辦，並籌款收鹽；

translations.literal: for nominally suspended port stations, select merchants to take over and also raise funds to purchase salt;
translations.idiomatic: for nominally suspended port stations, merchants should be selected to take over operations and funds should be raised to purchase salt;

sentences.zh: 緝私責成官商，由運司審覈；

translations.literal: responsibility for suppressing smuggling should rest on officials and merchants, to be reviewed by the salt transport commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: responsibility for suppressing smuggling should rest on officials and merchants, subject to review by the salt transport commissioner;

sentences.zh: 緝獲私鹽，分別充賞，及補課作正配銷；

translations.literal: when smuggled salt is seized, rewards should be distributed by grade, and back taxes should be applied to regular quota sales;
translations.idiomatic: seized smuggled salt should be rewarded by grade, and back taxes should count toward regular quota sales;

sentences.zh: 禁革引地陋規；

translations.literal: illicit customary fees in distribution districts should be prohibited and abolished;
translations.idiomatic: illicit customary fees in salt distribution districts should be abolished;

sentences.zh: 覈裁巡驗浮費。

translations.literal: inflated expenses for patrol and inspection should be verified and cut.
translations.idiomatic: inflated expenses for patrol and inspection should be verified and reduced.

sentences.zh: 尋查州縣倉庫，統計實虧之數，多至三百九十餘萬，請將虧數最多之員，革職，勒追；

translations.literal: He soon inspected prefectural and county granaries, totaling actual deficits that in many cases reached more than 3,900,000 taels, and requested that officials with the largest deficits be dismissed and compelled to make restitution;
translations.idiomatic: He soon inspected prefectural and county granaries and found actual deficits totaling more than 3,900,000 taels in many cases; he asked that officials with the largest shortfalls be dismissed and forced to make restitution;

sentences.zh: 不足，則由原任上司按成分賠，或由本省各官分成提補；

translations.literal: if insufficient, then former superiors should pay by assessed shares, or officials throughout the province should contribute in shares to make up the amount;
translations.idiomatic: if that proved insufficient, former superiors should pay proportional shares, or officials throughout the province should contribute proportionally to make up the loss;

sentences.zh: 其有欠在胥吏者，尤嚴補追，毋任倖免：並從之。

translations.literal: where deficits lay with clerks, recovery should be especially strict and no one permitted to escape: all approved.
translations.idiomatic: where deficits lay with clerks, recovery should be especially strict and no one allowed to escape liability: all approved.

sentences.zh: 授山西巡撫，未一月，召署吏部侍郎，命在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: Appointed Governor of Shanxi; within a month recalled to serve as acting Vice Minister of Personnel and ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed governor of Shanxi; within a month he was recalled to serve as acting vice minister of personnel and ordered to serve on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 尋授戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 三十年，擢左都御史。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year promoted Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was promoted left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，出為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he went out as Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 he was posted as governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 艇匪在浙洋劫掠山東兵船，被剿遁閩洋，遣水師截擊，賊眾畏罪投誠，分別安置。

translations.literal: Boat bandits in Zhejiang waters plundered Shandong military vessels; pursued they fled into Fujian waters; he sent naval forces to intercept, and the bandits, fearing punishment, surrendered and were settled separately.
translations.idiomatic: Boat bandits in Zhejiang waters plundered Shandong military vessels; pursued, they fled into Fujian waters; he sent naval forces to intercept them, and the bandits, fearing punishment, surrendered and were settled in separate groups.

sentences.zh: 二年，兼署福州將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year he concurrently served as acting Military Governor of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he also served as acting military governor of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 疏請停罷捐納舉人、附生之例；

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting abolition of the practice of purchasing juren and supplemental licentiate status by contribution;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized asking to abolish the practice of purchasing juren and supplemental licentiate status by contribution;

sentences.zh: 又奏禁鹽商代銷官運，以杜取巧：並從之。

translations.literal: He also memorialized prohibiting salt merchants from selling government-transported salt on behalf of officials, to stop evasion: all approved.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized prohibiting salt merchants from selling government-transported salt on officials' behalf, to stop evasion: all approved.

sentences.zh: 尋以疾乞休。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he requested retirement on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he asked to retire on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 芝昌以文字受宣宗特達之知，嘗曰：「汝為文，行所無事，譬之於射，五矢無一失。

translations.literal: Zhichang won the Daoguang Emperor's special favor through his writing; the emperor once said: "When you write, you act as if nothing were amiss—like archery, five arrows without a miss.
translations.idiomatic: Zhichang won the Daoguang Emperor's special favor through his writing; the emperor once said, "When you write, you proceed as if nothing were amiss—like archery, five arrows without a miss.

sentences.zh: 」及查辦長蘆、兩浙鹽務稱旨，遂驟進膺樞務。

translations.literal: " When his investigation of Changlu and the two Zhejiang salt administrations pleased the emperor, he was suddenly advanced to Grand Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " When his investigation of Changlu and the two Zhejiang salt administrations pleased the emperor, he was suddenly advanced to Grand Council service.

sentences.zh: 甫數月，宣宗崩，文宗猶欲用之，畀以外任。

translations.literal: Only a few months later the Daoguang Emperor died; the Xianfeng Emperor still wished to use him and gave him an outside appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Only a few months later the Daoguang Emperor died; the Xianfeng Emperor still wished to employ him and gave him an outside appointment.

sentences.zh: 未一歲，謝職歸。

translations.literal: Within less than a year he resigned and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Within less than a year he resigned and went home.

sentences.zh: 久之，卒於家，未予卹典。

translations.literal: After a long time he died at home without receiving condolence gifts by regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Long afterward he died at home without receiving the usual condolence gifts by regulation.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，署閩浙總督文煜奏陳政績，追諡文敏。

translations.literal: In early Guangxu Acting Governor-General Wen Yu memorialized his achievements, and he was posthumously given the name Wenmin.
translations.idiomatic: In early Guangxu, Acting Governor-General Wen Yu memorialized his achievements, and he was posthumously given the name Wenmin.

sentences.zh: 子念詒，道光三十年進士，官編修。

translations.literal: Son Nianyi, jinshi in the thirtieth year of Daoguang, served as compiler.
translations.idiomatic: His son Nianyi passed the jinshi examination in Daoguang 30 and served as a compiler.

sentences.zh: 孫邦楨，同治十二年進士，官至福建布政使。

translations.literal: Grandson Bangzhen, jinshi in the twelfth year of Tongzhi, rose to Fujian Provincial Treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Bangzhen passed the jinshi examination in Tongzhi 12 and rose to Fujian provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 論曰：承平，士大夫平進而致列卿，或以恪謹稱，或以文學顯，固不能盡有所建樹；

translations.literal: The commentator says: In times of peace, scholar-officials who advanced by routine to rank of minister might be praised for dutiful caution or distinguished for literary talent, yet could not all achieve notable accomplishments;
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: In peaceful times, scholar-officials who rose by routine to ministerial rank might be praised for dutiful caution or distinguished for literary talent, yet could not all achieve notable accomplishments;

sentences.zh: 或餘澤延世，子孫復繼簪纓，若白鎔、那清安、升寅諸人是也。

translations.literal: or their lingering favor might extend through generations, with sons and grandsons again inheriting official rank, as with Bai Rong, Na Qing'an, Sheng Yin, and others.
translations.idiomatic: or their lingering favor might extend through generations, with sons and grandsons again inheriting official rank, as with Bai Rong, Na Qing'an, Sheng Yin, and the like.

sentences.zh: 季芝昌晚遭殊遇，已值宣宗倦勤之年，暫任兼圻，奉身而退，其見幾知止者耶？

translations.literal: Ji Zhichang late in life met with extraordinary favor, already when the Daoguang Emperor was weary of governing; he briefly held concurrent frontier posts, then withdrew while preserving himself—was this not seeing the moment and knowing when to stop?
translations.idiomatic: Ji Zhichang late in life met with extraordinary favor, already when the Daoguang Emperor had grown weary of governing; he briefly held concurrent frontier posts, then withdrew while preserving himself—was this not seeing the moment and knowing when to stop?
